property_summary: For every admissible input, a completed call to Put(v) appends a Log history entry recording exactly that deposit, so the newest History(k-1) entry has Sender==depositor and Val==v; the mutant deletes AddMessage, so for some (actor, amount) the newest entry fails to match the deposit.
change_summary: Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log history.
